title: The narrator's bracketed hint '(Speak with X or Y to take a side, or to tell them to settle it.)' appeared several times, but no dialogue ever offered a literal neutral 'settle it' option - only 'back A', 'back B', or a risky will-check 'call it a draw' that still costs standing on a miss.
